neighbours.label: Anticipating a threshold or limit: the token just before a limit/cutoff word is due ('above a specified ⟦cutoff⟧', 'must not exceed', 'below a certain', 'the recommended maximum'); plain amounts without a limit are quiet
fire: Households with earnings above a specified amount lose the subsidy entirely.
The total weight of your luggage must not exceed twenty kilograms.
Once the reservoir falls below a certain level, pumping is suspended.
Only towns with a population above a given size receive the grant.
The noise from the site may not exceed the level set by the council.
Drivers travelling over the posted limit will be photographed.
Accounts whose balance drops below a specified minimum are charged a fee.
The concentration in drinking water should stay under the permitted maximum.
quiet: Households with children in school receive the subsidy every month.
The total weight of your luggage was about twenty kilograms.
The reservoir was built in the hills sixty years ago.
Only towns in the northern province receive the grant.
The noise from the site woke the neighbours every morning.
Drivers travelling to the coast will pass two bridges.
Accounts opened before March were moved to the new system.
The drinking water in the village comes from a deep well.

notes: Card: upper_bound =, 'above that amount', 'above a specified cutoff', 'must not exceed'; the - pole promotes ' ceiling', ' threshold(s)', ' min'. Probes: 'above a specified' 1.00, 'below a certain' 0.63, 'not exceed' 0.48 and 0.25, 'over the posted' 0.39, 'the recommended maximum' 0.39; plain amounts 0.01-0.05.
